name: RedactionLayer

test_list.description: Seeded fake secrets in message, Display, Debug and str fields never appear in the TUI ring, telemetry ring or file queue; masks are counted.
Same guarantee in JSON mode (per-field redaction).
Text without secrets is rendered as `message field=value ...` unchanged, message first.
Level and target of the tracing event reach the sinks.
A panicking redactor or one that reports an incomplete scan fails closed: the record reaches no sink and redact_failures is counted; the caller never panics.
Newlines, carriage returns and ESC in event text are escaped (no log or terminal injection).
JSON mode renders an object with one key per tracing field; numbers and booleans stay bare.
A numeric field whose text was masked is emitted as a quoted string.
An object too large for the line limit is shaped to fit with a _truncated marker instead of being cut mid-token.
An event above the raw formatting bound is replaced by a fixed stub (never partially scanned) and counted.
With a full file queue the emitting call returns and the drops are counted; the rings still receive every record.
A redactor that logs from inside redact_into neither deadlocks nor panics and later events still work (tracing-core discards the nested event).
proptest: for random surrounding text the secret never survives in any sink and the visible text is strictly shorter than the secret-bearing original.

inputs.name: event
inputs.description: Event to format, redact and enqueue.

output_description: Redacted record pushed to the configured sinks; formatting reuses thread-local buffers.
